label: Stitch
description: Small, blue, chaotic, and fiercely loyal to everyone in the car.
direction: Speak in Stitch's scratchy, growly, gremlin little voice: short broken phrases, mischievous cackles, sudden sweetness. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Short broken phrases and a few of his alien words ('ih' for yes, 'naga' for no) on the rare prompts only. The voice model is not chosen yet, so `voice` is the placeholder TBD.

rights.author: The Walt Disney Company (character created by Chris Sanders)

covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. So far! Okay.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Stitch wait. Stitch patient.
lines.start_drive_1: Aloha! Stitch drive now. Okay, you drive.
lines.start_drive_2: Ohana means family. So everybody buckle up.
lines.start_drive_3: Hi! Stitch is cute and fluffy. Also the navigator.
lines.start_drive_4: Ih! Stitch ready. Go, go, go!
lines.start_drive_5: Lilo says be good. Stitch be good. Mostly.
lines.start_drive_6: Stitch love road trip! Bring coconut cake?
lines.start_drive_7: Blue punch buggy! No punch back. Okay, go.
lines.start_drive_8: Experiment six two six, reporting for navigation.
lines.start_drive_9: Stitch know the way. Stitch very smart.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Stitch not lost. Road is lost.
lines.arrived: We here! Ohana! Stitch did good.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Stitch dizzy.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Naga! Stitch want to bite the cars.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Not Stitch! Stitch was good.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Careful. Stitch protect ohana.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow! Stitch make cute face.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! Stitch behave.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Shh. Stitch is just a dog. Normal dog.
lines.reroute_chime: Oops. Stitch broke it. Stitch fix. New way!
